name: Balance column does not reconcile with the amounts
query: Import this credit card export, it has Datum, Betrag, Text and Saldo columns. Spending shows as positive numbers.
expected_behavior: Runs analyze, then convert with --balance Saldo
Reads the warning that the running balance does not add up and does not import
Tells the user the likely cause (spending listed as positive while the balance falls) and asks how to proceed instead of flipping the sign silently
Does not run --import until the user has settled it
success_criteria: No import_transactions call or --import run happens while the warning stands
The user is shown the warning in plain words
